title: Transient Fluvial Iso-Chi Knickzone Downslope Back-Projection & Piedmont Hinge Reception (H86T-KNDS)
mechanism: Under Perron & Royden (2013) integral stream-power theory, a range-front normal fault slip increment produces a transient channel-steepness knickzone (elevated ksn_max_m0.9 and positive chi-step step_max_x1000 - step_min_x1000) that migrates upstream into the footwall at equal chi across parallel canyons of differing drainage area A, sitting at staggered Euclidean distances L(A) ~ A^(m/n) upstream of the actual buried range-front fault. H86T-KNDS applies a Pleistocene Lake Lahontan highstand hypsometric notch (1315-1355 m) and symmetric-Bouguer sill veto, projects footwall knickzone intensity downslope along the unit canyon gradient -grad(zmean_m)/||grad(zmean_m)|| across multi-scale area-weighted shifts s in {4, 8, 14, 22} px onto the piedmont basement-hinge reception zone (50 m < Z_b < 800 m, gated by horizontal gravity gradient Band 18), and filters for cross-canyon along-strike iso-chi coherence.
named_non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut shorelines (~1330 m highstand bench) and resistant Tertiary basalt/welded-tuff caprock ledges (suppressed via the 1315-1355 m Lahontan hypsometric notch filter and symmetric Bouguer gravity ridge veto).

arms.role: Primary candidate: 4-fold 12-px eroded LOQO two-regime HGB PU using all 17 features (4 KNDS back-projected iso-chi features + 4 local chi/10m-topo features + 9 native/fold-visible baseline features), 37,654 dots at 2.8 px Poisson-disk outside >3.0 px collar.

Unprojected local-chi ablation control: identical 4-fold eroded LOQO two-regime HGB PU with the 4 downslope back-projected KNDS features removed (13 features: 4 local chi/10m-topo + 9 native/fold-visible baseline), 37,654 dots at 2.8 px Poisson-disk outside >3.0 px collar.

Zero-chi native baseline control: identical 4-fold eroded LOQO two-regime HGB PU using only the 9 native/fold-visible baseline features (zero external chi/10m-DEM features), 37,654 dots at 2.8 px Poisson-disk outside >3.0 px collar.
